identity_evidence: '[No. 6527-A]'; 'December 21 19388' (OCR); additions and amendments to the Code of Fair Competition for the Petroleum Industry
outliers_found: petroleum code amendments: the Petroleum Code is the one that rested on section 9(c) (Panama Refining, January 7, 1935), and the text does not show that these amendments avoid 9(c)
basis: The order approves amendments to the Petroleum Code under Title I. Because the petroleum code's operative terms depended on section 9(c), held invalid on January 7, 1935, the end date may be earlier than June 16, 1935 and the order must be flagged rather than passed.
operative_quote:
do order that the attached additions and amendments to the
aforesaid Code of Fair Competition for the Petroleum Industry be, and they are

hereby approved.
notes: The attached amendments are not in the text, so whether they rely on section 9(c) cannot be checked. The text cites sections 2(a), 3, 4, 4(a) and 10(b) of Title I and does not mention 9(c). Likely NO still, with bound possibly 1935-01-07.
